How Refunds work

Modified on: Tue, 4 Jun, 2024 at 11:20 AM

The billing module lets the site admin refund payments that members made through the website.

Whether a refund is possible depends on the payment gateway. Some gateways do not allow refunds, some require a waiting period, and some have time limits (PayPal allows refunds for six months).

If the website changed payment gateways, older transactions must be refunded directly inside the original gateway account.

How to refund a payment

Follow these steps:

  1. Go to My Members » Search Members and find the member.
  2. Click Actions, then Payment History.

In the Transactions tab choose Actions » Refund Payment and confirm. The invoice then appears in the Refunded tab.

Existing Subscriptions

Refunding a payment does not cancel an active subscription. Recurring members continue to be billed until the subscription is cancelled manually.
